shared.style: Flamenco pop ballad with rumba strum, Spanish guitar, 105 BPM, G minor, Phrygian, Andalusian cadence. One young female voice singing in Mandarin Chinese, soulful and intimate in the verse, soaring long notes in the chorus, every word clear. In the verse a solo nylon-string Spanish guitar plays arpeggios and short falsetas over soft palmas; in the chorus rasgueado rumba strumming, cajon and palmas drive the rumba groove. Warm, longing, smiling. No male voice, no rap, no Chinese traditional instruments.

翻开来对一对，谁说中，谁先尝
